_comment: #396 'A Winter of Teeth', the FIGHT route end to end -- and the only live coverage the watch ask and the shepherd-as-ally have after the briar fights lost theirs. Night fixture at the shepherd: offer -> re-open the hub for the now-unlocked watch ask (banking hunter_will_come AFTER dialogue_ended, the end+effects ordering carried from the legacy `agreed` node) -> river_wolf_pack fires off its trigger_radius with the shepherd asserted on the player side INSIDE the open board -> the win banks survived_wolf_night and closes the resolve beat -> the WATCH report closes the quest. Also the text_variant precedence pin: with hunter_will_come and survived_wolf_night both banked, three variants match and the LAST one must win.
